messages:
sam: FYI — ACME flagged they need per-customer routing overrides (header-based) with an admin UI + audit trail. SE asked for an ETA.

maya: Can we do header-based routing off `x-tenant-id`? That's their ask. Need priority and a clear fallback policy.

rick: +1. Key questions: allow wildcard matches? who can request vs who can approve exceptions? allowlist vs denylist semantics? :thinking: 

sam: My take: allowlist for dedicated routing (explicit opt-in). Denylist for temporary blocks. All changes must be auditable and require an approval workflow. Also quota isolation: routed requests should count against org commit if using Dedicated. Billing team asked about that.

jamie: One more thing — KV/prefix cache affinity. If we change route mid-session to a fallback model we'll invalidate cache and latency spikes. We should support sticky routing (by token claim or session cookie).

maya: Agreed. Draft match ordering: 1) exact org header -> 2) pattern/wildcard -> 3) default route. Add `sticky_by` option. Quick DSL draft: 

```
- match:
    header: "x-org-id"
    pattern: "acme-*"
  action:
    route: "dedicated/acme-pool"
    priority: 90
    sticky_by: "auth.sub"
    quota_scope: "org"
```

maya: That keeps rules simple and predictable.

rick: Love the DSL. Also, console must show: effective route, match reason, matched header/value, and an "undo" for last change. Audit trail required (who/when/why).

sam: UX idea: add an "Enterprise exceptions" page where SEs can submit requests and Security/Product Ops approve. Notify via email + webhook. SEs can attach customer ticket id.

jamie: Ops note: we can't have unlimited per-org entries — routing table size impacts lookup time and kernel selection heuristics. Propose limit of 500 explicit org routes per region and fallback to pattern matches. Also add a TTL for temporary exceptions.

rick: Also need to emit telemetry events for every routing decision: `routing.match_type`, `routing.priority`, `routing.decision_time_ms`, and `routing.fallback_reason` if used. That will help Optimize recommendations.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: routing-service/v2 (schema v1.3). CI: passed. Canary scheduled. :rocket:

maya: Next steps: I'll open an RFC with config schema + HTTP API for route management. Jamie will prototype sticky token path and cache-affinity. Rick will spec Console screens and audit UX. Sam to coordinate approvals with Product Ops. Target: 2-week spike.

sam: Also please add a short eval: measure latency and token-cost delta when routing to Dedicated vs fallback model for typical 512-token chat.

rick: Will add telemetry and an automated eval.

sam: Thanks team :thumbsup:
